verdict.rationale: Signifyd offers a documented webhook subscription system: create webhooks via API (docs-7), configure them for guarantee decision events (docs-8, docs-27), with real-time notifications as an alternative to polling (docs-26). This directly satisfies webhook-based event subscription. missing for 10: no evidence of a broader event catalog beyond guarantee decisions, no payload schema documentation, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of reliability.
